== Summary ==
Slip “•New Hope” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF file created 13 October 2026), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 52, 1102, 775)).
